title: Extended Scheduler Metrics
description:
Add missing operational metrics:
- `scheduler_job_lock_wait_seconds` histogram — time spent acquiring job lock
- `scheduler_dispatch_latency_seconds` histogram — time from job received to dispatched
- `scheduler_active_goroutines` gauge — current HandlePacket goroutines
- `scheduler_reconciler_stale_jobs` gauge — stale jobs found per reconcile tick

**Files**: `core/controlplane/scheduler/engine.go`, `core/controlplane/scheduler/reconciler.go`
definitionOfDone: scheduler_reconciler_stale_jobs gauge set per reconcile tick

implementationPlan.description:
Step 1: Add new methods to the Metrics interface in types.go

Add to `Metrics` interface:
```go
ObserveJobLockWait(seconds float64)
ObserveDispatchLatency(topic string, seconds float64)
SetActiveGoroutines(count int)
```

Add to a new `ReconcilerMetrics` interface (or extend Metrics):
```go
SetStaleJobs(state string, count int)
```

Alternatively, add all to Metrics if reconciler already uses it. Check if Reconciler has a metrics field — it doesn't currently. Add one.
implementationPlan.note: Added 4 new methods to Metrics interface (ObserveJobLockWait, ObserveDispatchLatency, SetActiveGoroutines, SetStaleJobs) in both scheduler types.go and infra metrics.go. Added Prom fields (histogram, histogram vec, gauge, gauge vec) with registration. Added Noop stubs. Updated spyMetrics in pending_replayer_test.go. Added WithMetrics builder to Reconciler. Updated metrics_test.go assertions.
Instrumented withJobLock: record lockStart before loop, observe lock wait duration after acquisition succeeds.

implementationPlan.description:
Step 3: Instrument dispatch latency in processJob

In `engine.go` `processJob()`, record `dispatchStart := time.Now()` at function entry. After successful publish + state transition to DISPATCHED, observe:
```go
if e.metrics != nil {
    e.metrics.ObserveDispatchLatency(topic, time.Since(dispatchStart).Seconds())
}
```
implementationPlan.note: Added dispatchStart := time.Now() at processJob entry (after validation). Observe dispatch latency after successful publish + incJobsDispatched.
Added activeHandlers atomic.Int64 field to Engine. In HandlePacket, increment on entry with SetActiveGoroutines, decrement in deferred cleanup.

implementationPlan.description:
Step 5: Add metrics to Reconciler for stale jobs count

Add `metrics Metrics` field to Reconciler struct and `WithMetrics` builder. In `handleTimeouts()`, after listing stale jobs, set gauge:
```go
if r.metrics != nil {
    r.metrics.SetStaleJobs(string(state), len(records))
}
```
implementationPlan.note: Instrumented handleTimeouts to call SetStaleJobs after listing stale records, reporting count per state (including 0 when none found).

implementationPlan.description:
Step 6: Verify all tests pass and go vet clean

Run `go test ./core/controlplane/scheduler/... -count=3` and `go vet ./core/controlplane/scheduler/...`. Tests use nil metrics so new methods won't affect them.
implementationPlan.note: All tests pass: scheduler (1.910s) and metrics (0.625s). go vet clean for both packages.
